metadata.capture_mode: repeatable-read read-only catalog queries; no application row data

constraints.name: fk_ai_analyses_market_snapshot_id_market_snapshots

constraints.name: fk_market_observations_instrument_id_market_instruments

constraints.name: ck_risk_register_ck_risk_register_materiality_allowed
constraints.definition: CHECK (materiality::text = ANY (ARRAY['Low'::character varying, 'Moderate'::character varying, 'Major'::character varying, 'Catastrophic'::character varying]::text[]))
